newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures extend gains after Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures extend gains after Greenspan.

text.p: July 22 - U.S. debt futures extended gains after Greenspan Humphrey-Hawkins comments. Sept T-bonds reach new daily high at 114-25/32. "They're not in any hurry to raise rates," a T-bond trader said. "Everything he said is very moderate and the market likes it." Greenspan said Fed may eventually need to change rates, but for now growth slowing. Said FOMC confident of modest 1997 inflation, but sees rise in 1998.
